content: The Lab is freemium. Six SEL comics are free forever (Solving Problems With Friends · Growing Your Brain Power Every Day! · Magic Words: Grow Your Brain Bigger · Train Like a Champion · Level Up Your Mind Game · Stay Strong: A Resilience Toolkit) plus Little Lab letters A-F, plus one rotating free story each month. Everything else needs the membership ($4.99/mo · $36/yr · $99/yr classroom). Never say "25 free" or "free to play" as a blanket claim; per-story "free" claims only on the six. No em dashes in any posted copy.
title: Truth-in-copy rule (Aug 17, 2026)
